metadata.full_snippet: On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/23 I received an alert from [Redacted] that a major derogatory mark had been made on my credit report with [Redacted] by Central Portfolio Control for an account I was not aware of. After checking the other two bureaus, I saw that the same mark had been made on my [Redacted] report as well. I have not received any contact by this debt collection agency by phone, email, or mail with regard to an outstanding debt. It is my understanding that before a debt collector can report a debt to a credit reporting company, the debt collector has to either speak with me in person or over the phone about the debt, mail me a letter about the debt and wait a reasonable amount of time ( generally 14 days ) for a notice that the letter wasnt delivered, or send me an electronic communication about the debt and wait a reasonable amount of time ( generally 14 days ) for a notice that the message wasnt delivered. I have not received any such communication, and yet the debt has been reported to two major credit bureaus and negatively impacted my credit score. I was not provided any information about what the debt is, verification that it belongs to me and hasn't been paid off, or info on how to dispute it.

You and your inaccurate reporting have destroyed my livelihood. You have caused my daughter and me, severe harm due to the negligence and inaccurate advertising on my consumer report. I am thoroughly exhausted of your [Redacted]. Between being a single mother struggling to make ends meet and maintaining the household through a pandemic, after a pandemic with inflation at an all-time high, I do NOT have the time for your [Redacted]. You are breaking federal law. metadata.full_snippet:
On Thursday, [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2023, I deposited a check from my employer in the amount of {$910.00} via Chime 's mobile app. I've done this many times previously, and have never had an issue with getting access to my funds. 

However, the app estimated that Chime wouldn't release the funds until Thursday, [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2023. After spending over two hours on the phone with CSRs who could barely speak and understand [Redacted] ( having [Redacted] is fine, except in matters of understanding your customers ), I was told that I could transfer my money to a questionable check cashing app, or transfer it to another financial institution. Should I take the second option, I was told that I could expect a " chargeback '' from Chime for the full amount. 

My issue is that none of the CSRs or the supervisors I spoke to would make any amount of the funds available, despite having the abilty to do so. When one of them confirmed that the check was still processing, I asked to cancel the deposit. Upon my asking, this supervisor suddenly saw that the check had been accepted, and the deposit couldn't be canceled. Despite this change in the check 's status, she couldn't give me a date on which I could expect to receive my money. 

To be clear, Chime has previously processed checks from this issuer on my behalf in the past without a problem,, so I don't understand the issue now. I also don't understand why I was given evasive answers. 

I shouldn't have to wait days to access what is rightfully mine, and certainly not without an adequate explanation as to why I have to wait at all. I don't know what to make of the questionable and possibly illegal suggestions one supervisor gave me.

metadata.full_snippet:
To be clear to start, the issue is that I could not get anyone on the phone to understand that the material misrepresentation about payment posting on the website was something that needed to be addressed. Their process to resolve my misapplied payment makes no sense, but it did get fixed after speaking with the company. 

The Hyundai Finance website states that overpayments will be applied to principal once the current bill and any outstanding bills/fees are satisfied. It lists a slightly different posting order for payments under or over {$2500.00}, but both sections state that overpayment will be applied to principal directly. 

I made my first payment on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], before the due date of [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. I called on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] to ask why the excess had been applied to my following bill instead of principal. The final response I got from my first call was that excess payment is in fact applied to principal and that that is what happened with my payment. 

This did not seem right as I could see that my following bill had been reduced by the extra amount, so it appeared it had not been applied to principal. I called back to verify and the second person I spoke with informed me of the actual policy ( that overpayments on sums under {$2500.00} are NOT applied to principal unless you make a payment then call back two days later to have it reversed and reapplied to principal. ) I tried to inform him that the only available place that I could find in my loan documents or the website stated a different posting method, ( one that is clearly more beneficial to the borrower 's interest paid, ) and he could only " apologize for the incomplete information on the website. '' That is not " incomplete information, '' that is a material misrepresentation that causes the borrower to pay more interest than the posting method stated on their website.

My loans have been on the same repayment schedule since my g...
metadata.full_snippet:
Hello, I am writing to express concern about PSLF payment counts incongruences, Mohelas unresponsiveness to me, unwillingness to correct their mistake, and everchanging reasoning for a differing loan count upon inquiry. My loans have been on the same repayment schedule since my graduation in [Redacted]. As such, my qualifying PSLF payments have consistently reflected this. However, my loan payment count has changed with Mohlea without given reason. Specifically, loans 1-5 on my account are listed as having 112 qualifying payments ( 5 needing employment certification ) and loan 6 lists 110 qualifying payments ( 5 needing employment certification ). I have contacted Mohela 6 times about this incongruence ( 3 times by phone and 3 times by email ) and have been provided 3 different reasons as to why my payment count is differing between my loans. 

I am writing to request the assistance of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to hold Mohela accountable for the inaccuracies in my payment count and to ensure that all 6 of the loans reflect the 112 payments I have made while working fulltime in public service. 

On [Redacted] I called Mohela PSLF Support at [Redacted]. I initially spoke to [Redacted]. I explained the inconsistencies in loan count. Was then transferred to [Redacted] who stated I appeared to have an in-school deferment for loan 6 for [Redacted] and [Redacted] of [Redacted]. I shared that I did not have a deferment during this period and was working full time. Was then transferred to [Redacted] [Redacted] who was accompanied by a trainer on the phone ) She reviewed My Fed Loan information received from this previous server. Stated that 1/2 of the page sent from My Fed Loans was missing and did not show all completed payments. She stated she would submit a request for review of all payments. She asked for EIN for [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted], which I provided. I shared with [Redacted] that I have documentation from My Fed Loan [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] and [Redacted] company approval and PSLF counted payments for [Redacted], and that I can provide this information. Was placed on hold for 30 minutes, then the call abruptly ended. 

On [Redacted] I uploaded documentation from My Fed Loan which demonstrated I made payments on loan 6 in [Redacted] and [Redacted] of [Redacted]. I requested a recount of my qualifying payments be completed and that all of my eligible payments were reflected in said count. 

I received a response on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] stating that a supervisor would call me to discuss the issue within 72 business hours. I was never called. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] I wrote to Mohela stating that I had not been contacted by a supervisor. I received a response saying I would be contacted within 72 business hours. 

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] I called to request to speak with a supervisor. I initially spoke to [Redacted] who ignored my request to speak to a supervisor. She investigated my loan account and told me the reason my [Redacted] & [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] payments do not count on PSLF is because the payment update request I submitted to My Fed Loan in [Redacted] listed my [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] and [Redacted] employment end date on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], but the document was signed on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. Again, I referred to the documentation I submitted from MyFed Loan stating my loan payments from [Redacted] qualify for PSLF via my full-time employment with [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] and [Redacted] [Redacted] She stated this document is not adequate and I need to submit documentation from [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] and [Redacted] that is singed the last day of my employment with that company. I then asked to be transferred to a supervisor. I was then on hold for 40 minutes before calling back and asking to speak with a supervisor. I initially spoke to [Redacted], who stated she was transferring me to a supervisor. I then spoke to [Redacted], who shared she was not a supervisor. I asked to speak to a supervisor. I was then placed on hold for [Redacted] minutes at which point I had to hang-up to attend to my work at a childrens hospital. 

In summary, I have been told loan 6 has a differing payment count because of an in-school deferment, because only the page of verification came from My Fed Loan was missing, and finally because the date a payment update request that I sent in [Redacted] was allegedly incongruent. This appears to be bureaucratic incompetence at best and volitional corruption at worst. 

I need the assistance of the CFBP to communicate with Mohlea and have my PSLF payment counts reflect the time I have worked full time. 

Thank you.

The portal asked if I had any evidence to upload to the dispute to which I responded yes. The dispute was submitted without an option to upload any documents. This dispute only needed to be viewed once if the portal would allow me to upload the documentation the first time. Having a consumer go into a branch or fax documents is an antiquated system. If my dispute is submitted electronically, I expect to be able to submit the supporting documents for my dispute at the same time. While this wait is going on, the payment amount being disputed has not been refunded. This system is built to protect the bank and the seller, not the consumer.

metadata.full_snippet:
Consolidated loans in [Redacted]. Working for PSLF-qualifying employers since then. Reached 120 eligible payments in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. 

Loans previously services by [Redacted], transferred to Mohela in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], with payment counts gradually updated to the account. As of [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], account reflected >120 eligible, 110 qualifying. I submitted my last ECF form on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] to certify the last 10 months of employment and apply for PSLF. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] the form was processed, but my payment counts were not updated. I called Mohela customer service on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and was informed that the form was processed and that my payment counts will update, but that it could take up to 30 days. She stated that I just need to " be patient '' and I will receive a letter when the payments are updated to reflect the form. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I received a letter from Mohela stating that I am not eligible for PSLF. The letter stated that I had the same 110 qualifying payments. The same letter listed the end date for my current employer as [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], which is the date I submitted a prior ECF for this employer ( in other words, the [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] form is still not reflected ). I called Mohela again [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and was told by the representative that the form was approved and had the correct dates, so my payments will update within the next few weeks and the loans will automatically be sent to Dept of Ed for loan discharge at that time. They stated that process will take an additional 90 business days before they get approval from Dept of Ed, then an additional 90 business days before the loans are fully forgiven and cleared from Mohela site. 

Today ( [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] ) I logged in to the Mohela chat feature because I felt I should get this information in writing. This time I was connected to [Redacted], who informed me that the [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] ECF was actually NOT approved and that is why my payments are not showing as qualifying. She also stated " however I do not see anything wrong with the application '' and will submit the form to a supervisor for review, which will take up to 14 days to process. I asked how to follow up with the supervisors directly, and was told to wait and I will receive a notice when the review is complete. 

At this point, I have worked in public service and made income-based payments for over 10 years. I have been eligible for loan forgiveness for 5 months. I submitted appropriate documentation almost 3 full months ago to satisfy requirements for loan discharge. After taking 2 months just to process the form, they gave me false reassurance twice about the processed form that further delayed my application by an additional month ( 2 weeks since being processed with zero communication that the form was actually rejected until I logged into the chat today, an an additional 2 weeks for supervisor review ). Even the [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] letter does not state that the [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] form was rejected.

metadata.full_snippet: In Feb/Mar [Redacted] prior to the Covid pandemic I had made a charge to my [Redacted] card for a purchase. I am single and not married and live alone and had to leave my residence at [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] MA to care for an elderly parent with demential who was widowed and who was quarantined. A [Redacted] bill had been due to be paid and I had mistakenly believed the account was on auto-pay which it had been in the past and as I seldomly used the store credit card I did not realize the statement had been mailed to my home address. When I was able to return to my residence which was in a very high risk [Redacted] area in my State where people were asked not to visit and to remain sheltered in place I noticed a bill in my mailbox and realized it was not paid. I immediately contacted [Redacted] and discussed the situation with them. They were able to remove some late charges which I appreciated but were not willing to adjust the impact to my credit report. Knowing that I would not be returning to the home again for quite some time I specifically asked to pay the account in full to pay the balance owed. At this time I felt the matter was resolved to my satisfaction. A couple of months later I returned to the home again and noticed another [Redacted] invoice in the mail. At this time after opening the invoice I realized that they had not in fact processed the full payment ( their was some residual owed ) and I believe this was intentional as the balance was minimal at the time and I provided my payment information and specifically asked them to take care of what I owed which they apparently did not. I asked for the payment provided over the phone to pay the balance off in full and I fully expect the company to properly process these payments correctly. I called them back again and asked for this to be settled and they did finally clear the balance and I closed the account. Unfortunately this error on [Redacted] behalf has seriously impacted my credit score. I have tried unsuccessfully on multiple occasions to resolve this with [Redacted] credit department which I believe is an absolute abuse due to the circumstances. I have also filed a discrepancy report with Equifax in [Redacted] of [Redacted] and no changes were made. The dispute # is [Redacted] I am more than willing to accept my responsibility for a single late payment which I did not make on time when it was due in [Redacted]. It was a simple oversight and as my FICO report reflects I have faithfully made on time payments to all my creditors for almost 20 years. However the back to back late payment blemishes ( 60 days ) on my record from [Redacted] due to their inability to process my payment correctly has significantly damaged my very long and virtually unblemished credit history. A fair resolution to this matter would be for [Redacted] to correct the reporting and take responsibility for failing to process my payment properly and remove the 60 day delinquency in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. Simply crediting me for late fees is not an acceptable resolution. Furthermore I have requested an ( AW ) code be added due to the pandemic. It is absurd for this incident to damage my [Redacted] score significantly during these times when we are talking about a mere {$200.00} which I had the full ability to pay had the call center processed it correctly. I believe far more leniency and forgiveness has been provided to [Redacted] consumers who had balances they could not pay and for consumers who have missed multiple payments throughout this pandemic. I find it reprehensible for them to simply send a boiler plate letter to dismiss my legitimate claim for arbitration in this matter. I believe this to be discriminatory to me as a former customer in good standing and I would expect that this situation be resolved accordingly.

I submitted a dispute against all charges on or after [Redacted] o...
metadata.full_snippet:
I am writing to submit a complaint about Discovers Fraud Protection Services and their failure to complete a reasonable and thorough investigation into the Identity Theft and Fraud that was committed against me. 

I submitted a dispute against all charges on or after [Redacted] on a Discover Card account ending [Redacted] as unauthorized. They denied my dispute and supported their denial with payments I made on the account in [Redacted]. Their evidence is prior to the date my dispute begins and is therefore irrelevant to my dispute. Let me explain : I recently learned that my soon-to-be ex-spouse has committed significant identity theft and credit card fraud against me. He found some old credit cards of mine that I thought were closed and used them without my knowledge or consent. ( He also opened several credit cards using my personal information, without my consent or knowledge. ) My soon-to-be-ex spouse then built up a lot of debt in my name, mostly to fuel his addictive habits that he had led me to believe were under control. To my knowledge, I did not benefit from any of these unauthorized charges. He accomplished this because he was abusive and controlling and had full control of the mail, and because he took advantage of my vision impairment to ensure that I did not have access to any evidence of these debts that arrived by mail. I am working with a lawyer and have filed police reports and reports with the FTC. 

With the help of staff at my attorney 's office, I found that beginning sometime during or after [Redacted] he charged thousands of dollars to an old Discover card of mine, account ending [Redacted]. He then tried to pay it down without my knowledge by opening an account with a debt repair company called [Redacted], also in my name and without my knowledge or consent. Most disturbing is that he appears to have also forged my signature on a court settlement agreement with Discover as well. 

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] we submitted a complaint packet for this unauthorized use of this account. The packet included : -- a cover letter from my attorney explaining the situation -- a letter from me detailing the fraud ; how I learned about it, how I understand it occurred ; how my spouse admitted to it ; and requesting that they cancel the account and find me not responsible for the debt because the charges were unauthorized. 

Discover did not reply for a long time. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] they requested additional information, including information that we had already sent. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], we sent them an additional packet of information, including Discovers additional information form, where I made clear that I was disputing all charges after [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. 

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] Discover responded that they did not accept our dispute. They claimed that their investigation found the account balance to be accurate. For supporting documentation, they sent images of checks that I had written in [Redacted]. 

Their supporting documentation demonstrates that they did not conduct a thorough investigation based on the facts that we shared. I opened this account some years ago, but I had stopped using it. I explained on their fraud form that I was disputing all charges during and after the year [Redacted]. The fact that I made payments on the account in [Redacted] is irrelevant to the complaint that I submitted. It was not until sometime around or after [Redacted] that my spouse began putting unauthorized charges on the account. Therefore, payments I made in [Redacted] are NOT evidence that charges made on the account after [Redacted] are authorized. 

If Discover had done a thorough investigation, they would have found enough evidence to determine that I had stopped using this card and this debt is not mine and is a product of unauthorized use, such as : A significant gap in use of this card between when I stopped using it and when my spouse found it and began using it without my permission. 
All wet ink signatures on any documents after [Redacted] do not match wet ink signatures from when I opened the account or on checks I wrote to make payments prior to [Redacted]. 

Discover did not conduct a reasonable investigation into these unauthorized charges. I feel that their " fraud protection services '' are not protecting consumers like me.

metadata.full_snippet:
This letter is a formal complaint that you are reporting inaccurate and incomplete credit information on my consumer report. 
I have recently reviewed my consumer report and noticed some unauthorized accounts and in violation of 15 U.S. Code 1681 ( a ) ( 3 ) you guys assumed this role without my permission and you DID NOT have my consent. You guys did not respect my right to privacy which is under 15 U.S. Code 1681 ( a ) ( 4 ). You did not exercise your grave responsibility at all and you were unfair and partial. I have already taken the liberty to file a CFPB report and an Attorney General complaint. You were never given permissible purpose Under 15 U.S. Code 1681b ( a ) ( 2 ). I never instructed you guys to furnish this report and I never consented to this report in the first place, What I am demanding right now is that you guys delete all of these accounts listed below off of my report immediately.

I would like to state pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 1681 ( a ) ( 1 ) that the banking system is dependent upon fair and accurate consumer reporting. By allowing these inaccuracies to be furnished on my consumer report, it may cause me to lose confidence in the banking system.

According to my written instructions which I have full authority to give you under my rights as a natural person/consumer pursuant to 15 U.S Code 1681b ( a ) ( 2 ) I am exercising my right and I demand these inaccurate accounts be deleted immediately. Willful noncompliance by your company will result in me seeking legal action. 

WRITTEN INSTRUCTION DELETE FOLLOWING ACCOUNTS ( [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] )

metadata.full_snippet:
We purchased a certified pre-owned [Redacted] Ford [Redacted] Pickup from [Redacted] Ford in [Redacted] AZ on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. 

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I parked the vehicle in the employee parking area behind my building and there was a severe rainstorm that day. When I unlocked the vehicle to go home, upon opening the door water poured out of the vehicle in a steady stream, and water continuously poured from the roof area in the cab. The amount of water that was pouring into the cab saturated all areas of the cab, the floors, doors, roof liner and dashboard. 

We brought the truck home and contacted [Redacted] Ford to explain the issue and ask for service. We never received a phone call return for our service request after 2 phone calls, so we reached out to Warranty number and took the vehicle to [Redacted] Ford in [Redacted] AZ on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. The dealer was closer to our location in [Redacted] [Redacted] and had a sooner appointment time. 

We were able to drive the vehicle to the dealership, upon pulling into the driveway, the truck dashboard went completely black and the vehicle stalled. The service teams had to push the truck back to the service area. We explained the situation of service representative [Redacted] at that point and when he went out to the vehicle, he noticed the moisture in the cab and told us that he will write things up and give us a call. 

We called the dealership for a follow up as we did not hear from them on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], [Redacted] and [Redacted]. Left several messages for the service advisor and asked to speak to another person. We were told [Redacted] would return our messages. On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], we drove out to the [Redacted] dealership and found our truck in the very far back of the lot against a wall, uncovered, and when looking into the truck, there was even more water in puddles on the floor ( there were 5 more storms since the drop off ). There was a strong must odor from the car and black mold on the seats.

We then called the dealership on that following Monday and we asked for [Redacted] and we were told that he quit the dealership on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and then notes stated on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], he left a message to order a windshield. 

After the lack of attention to the vehicle at [Redacted], I then called the Ford Corporate offices to ask for assistance as the vehicle had no follow up and was left out in the elements unattended for more water damage to occur. Speaking with [Redacted] [Redacted] as my claim advisor on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], we had a claim number assigned and [Redacted] was then going to reach out to [Redacted] to have the vehicle evaluated. [Redacted] made phone calls, multiple emails and messages through the Ford corporate communication portal and [Redacted] failed to respond to her requests for evaluation of our car. [Redacted] then contacted us on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] to say that since there was no communication from [Redacted], that her manager agreed to have the vehicle towed to another dealership of our choice to have the vehicle evaluated. We decided to have the vehicle closer to home in [Redacted] [Redacted], AZ The vehicle was towed to [Redacted] Ford in [Redacted] [Redacted], AZ on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. The truck was pushed off the tow truck as it would not start. Our service advisor is [Redacted] and he called us to let us know the vehicle arrived. When they opened the doors water poured out of the cab and water swashed inside the door panels. There was even water inside the top brake light on the cab as water was also trapped in the ceiling area of the truck. 

The [Redacted] Ford team has pulled all carpets, floorboards, headliners, and seats from the vehicle and all was covered with black mold on everything. They opened the dashboard and found a wiring harness submerged in water in there and rendering the truck inoperable. The service team has calculated the work so far that was done and the parts required to continue evaluation of the vehicle at {$8000.00}. Also, the wiring harness that is required for further evaluation is on INDEFINITE backorder nationwide with Ford with No date of arrival. The truck is at a standstill as without the harness, the evaluation can not be performed.

Ford Corp, has no answers as to when or how long this repair will take place, if at all. Also, we have been without a vehicle as Ford said the vehicle has to be formally " diagnosed ''. Well no part to complete the diagnosis, we have NO DIAGNOSIS and NO VEHICLE. 

We have been paying the monthly payments on this vehicle during this time, We also have paid full coverage insurance also. From [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] to this day, we have not had the vehicle and no rental either. We are totally frustrated as we are paying for a vehicle we do not have use of and no date of completion for diagnosis, which is therefore we don't even know if the vehicle can be repaired. We have made full payments for [Redacted], [Redacted] and [Redacted]. We are about to make the [Redacted] payment at the date of this communication. How long do we pay for a vehicle that we will not have use for? 

Thank you for listening.

metadata.full_snippet:
This is a portion of a letter written by order of the Vermont Superior Court during the telephone conference on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. All evidence and documentation held by the Vermont Superior Court. 


In [Redacted], one year after I was laid off and unable to find work, we applied for numerous programs through the Making Home Affordable program. We were required to work with the lender ( Wells Fargo ), providing applications and much paperwork and background information. Over the course of many months our paperwork was lost several times ( according to telephone conversations with representatives at Wells Fargo ), requiring new documentation be generated by us ( because according to them it was now out of date being some weeks later and we would have to start over ). It is important that it be known that we had never been late on, or missed a full payment at this time. This went on for some time until they began cashing our payment checks but not applying them to our account. We began receiving letters and phone calls from Wells Fargo demanding payment ( even though we had paid, on time ) and threatening credit reporting and eventual foreclosure ( again, we had never been late on, or missed, a full payment ). After much effort I was able to talk to someone who understood what was going on. She said our payments were placed in a special escrow account for people like us until the application process through the Making Home Affordable program was complete. 

I asked how I could avoid a negative credit rating and was told that they would apply our payments if we stopped applying for aid through Making Home Affordable. I had no choice but to agree to stop the application, and they applied our payments to our account. 

End of Letter We eventually did refinance independently of Wells Fargo but were forced to abandon the house because of work. Our complaint is that Wells Fargo has excluded us from the Court Order requiring them to make amends with consumers whom suffered from their business practices.

Their system is highly unfair and places unrealistic expectations onto borrowers, only to potentially be rejected anyway because application decisions are made at Navient 's discretion ( which I am certain me...
metadata.full_snippet:
My complaint is in regards to the way Navient handles cosigner release. Their system is highly unfair and places unrealistic expectations onto borrowers, only to potentially be rejected anyway because application decisions are made at Navient 's discretion ( which I am certain means they have every right to reject any application simply because they feel like it and not for a legitimate reason ).

I applied for cosigner release once in the past, only to be told that I was ineligible for it due to my enrollment in an income-based repayment program ( which Navient itself does not offer ). I believed at the time this was due to my federal loans being enrolled in Income-Based Repayment ( IBR ) prior to my federal loans being serviced by [Redacted]. 

However, upon taking a closer look at the terms and conditions of cosigner release, I am also ineligible for this service currently because of the fact I am enrolled in an Extended repayment plan rather than the [Redacted] repayment plan. On top of this, I would also be expected to make twelve consecutive on-time payments, which is the only reasonable stipulation they have.

This is very unfair to borrowers. They and their cosigners should not be punished with ineligibility for cosigner release just because of the plan the borrower is enrolled in. Navient places too many obstacles in the way because they want to ensure that their borrowers never have the opportunity to release their cosigners. I can not speak for anyone else, but my cosigner is in their [Redacted] and they should not have to worry about having this hanging over their heads. 

In addition, it is my understanding that cosigner release, once the application is received, can take up to two years to go through and for the cosigner to actually be released from the borrower 's account. This is a wholly arbitrary and unnecessary period of time with no basis whatsoever in logic. There is no reason at all that simply removing a name from an account should take 24 months on top of everything else.

Furthermore, Navient requires a copy of the borrower 's credit report, college diploma, transcript. Again, more unnecessary documentation. It should not matter what my credit score is or whether or not I graduated college. Neither of these has any bearing at all on the debt someone holds with Navient.

I fully believe this is yet another attempt by Navient to discourage borrowers from trying to free their cosigners. This decision-making process should take no more than 6-8 weeks maximum. I have never once heard of anyone successfully having their cosigner released, either from Navient or any other student loan lender, so why is it even offered when no one can make use of it?

It also seems highly unnecessary for Navient to need to know things such as my employer, my income, my rent and my other monthly payments, as well as requiring proof of income and tax forms. Their only concern should be whether or not I make my payments to them every month. They have no need for this additional information, yet they require borrowers to fill out a form including all of this before they will even consider releasing the borrower 's cosigner.

metadata.title: Credit card or prepaid card Dispute
metadata.snippet: I am writing in regarding the unfair and deceptive practices Synchrony Bank used on me. This is regarding the accounts I had with them where I reported the card stolen. In my personal experience with Synchrony Bank 's practices makes me wonder what the truth is that I'm being tol...
metadata.full_snippet:
I am writing in regarding the unfair and deceptive practices Synchrony Bank used on me. This is regarding the accounts I had with them where I reported the card stolen. In my personal experience with Synchrony Bank 's practices makes me wonder what the truth is that I'm being told. It also makes me question what ever this bank sends me in writing if I should question if this is the truth I'm being told or if this would be a lie. I've learned the hard way letters, documents, bank statements don't mean anything for proof. It's just like junk mail it means nothing for a consumer 's protection. 

The first store card nightmare experience that is still ongoing is with [Redacted] [Redacted]. Back in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] the [Redacted] [Redacted] credit card was pd in full and paid off. Since I was never given any statements for this account I would always have to call in to check on the account transactions, etc. I also was not able to set up a online account where I could see my account online. All I would get was error messages. 
When I had to report my card being stolen by one of the store employees. I was assured I wouldn't be held reliable for all the charges that was put through on my account. Even on the document that is attached to your new card that is mailed out to consumers even stated " For your protection, your account has {$0.00} fraud liability. '' This in my own experience is 100 % false and misleading. 

I received some letters from Synchrony Bank regarding the outcome of their investigation back in [Redacted]. I didn't think anything about the typos that was put on these letters then. Now to have these be used against me from another company 's collection agency trying to recollect on a card that I reported stolen to Synchrony Bank. I was completely blindsided on this latest deceptive move regarding Synchrony Bank. 

I was under the impression that the advertised {$0.00} Fraud Liability and the written letters, emails, 1099C ( that I received this year while I'm being sued for this ) was my proof. I also have phone recordings where I am still able to call in and access this card account after putting in my account number ( this is both saying the account number into the phone and also punching the account numbers in the phone. If this account wasn't active I wouldn't be able to get into my account over the phone like I always did before this happened. In these recordings it gives choices ( after you put in your account number, where it states to bring up your account ) to make a dispute or check status of a existing dispute, to make a payment, to check on your 1099c tax form. 

According to the collection agency that filed a lawsuit against me on this alleged account their client bought from Synchrony Bank, that all letters, documents, all correspondence I had with Synchrony bank including all the letters I wrote are now alleged as not received and never was sent out according to what they said Synchrony Bank claims. 

This collection agency never contacted me, their " alleged '' client never contacted me regarding this matter. The only contact I received is from is the courts. This debt wasn't even attempted to be validated until after the lawsuit was already filed. No proof was provided to back their claims or anything. 

Due to my rights being violated, along with the Fair Debt Collect Act, the Fair Credit Reporting Act, etc never being followed I am now forced into paying someone else 's purchases. 

How is this a trustworthy bank? 

The second store card nightmare is regarding the [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] credit card. I filed a complaint to your office regarding this matter clear back in [Redacted]. The case number is [Redacted]. The reason I'm bringing this back to light is because of a letter I received from Synchrony Bank regarding the dispute of this stolen card. This new letter undermines what the written response was to the original complaint I filed with your office. It also goes onto state Synchrony Bank identified an error in the resolution of your prior dispute initiated on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. This account was already closed as of the complaint I filed with you back in [Redacted]. The only account that had a dispute initiated around this time was [Redacted] [Redacted] not [Redacted] 's [Redacted]. As of this date of this complaint being filed no check has been issued since this account was closed. 

The third store card nightmare that is ongoing is with the [Redacted] credit card. Since this card was also reported stolen by a store employee. Again I was assured I wouldn't be held reliable for these purchases. Synchrony Bank took legal action against me to try to collect on the purchases that was made when the card was reported stolen. Since I filed a counterclaim against them regarding this I never heard anything more after the lawsuit was dropped until this year. I received a 1099c tax document from Synchrony Bank that was enclosed in with the 1099c tax document for [Redacted] [Redacted] store card. 

I'm leery on what to do with these tax documents since Synchrony Bank has a history of denying sending out certain letters or documents to their liking. According to the collect agency regarding the [Redacted] [Redacted] matter, they claim that Synchrony Bank told them that they never mailed me out " Any '' 1099c tax documents. If this is the case where did the tax id numbers come from? 


Lately with the experience I've been dealing with on the deceiving and dishonest practices, is Synchrony Bank going to wait another over 5 years to claim they made more errors, but never follow through with anything? 

More rights need to be given to consumers regarding these unfair and deceptive practices being used against consumers. Letters, documents, bank statements, emails, etc that is given to consumers should have more legal weight of proof for consumers. Not having a unfair and deceptive company claiming these documents are not theirs and the consumer has no way of fairly backing up these claims. Which in return makes the broken legal system even more unfairly one-sided.

metadata.full_snippet: On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2018 I purchased a 2018 [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] sedan from the [Redacted] dealership in [Redacted] Maryland, on I believe what was a second time buyers program for people who had low or bad credit. Of course I was told I can get put in something that wouldn't cost me a lot when it ended up costing me more than I'm able to pay. And to my recollection my credit wasn't too good, but it was above [Redacted]. When speaking with the finance guy informed him more than once that the price he gave me for a car note each month would be too high considering all the other bills I would have to pay. I asked if there was any way that they could bring the car note down even if it was only about {$100.00}. I was told more than once that they could not bring it down due to my credit score and that after on time payments of about 12 to 18 months that I could refinance which after sitting there for two hours talking to him about the situation he knew that I wouldn't be able to but continue to sell me the car. Almost since I've had the car it's called me unnecessary stress because I have not been able to keep the payments up which means I was never able to refinance. And after asking my finance company over the years more than once if they did refinancing they told me they do not but I looked it up online and it showed that they do. My car has been in possession status once and almost possible repossession status once twice. Now 5 years later I look and I still have {$24000.00} after already paying {$24000.00}. when a total price of the vehicle was financed for {$20.00}, [Redacted] in which I'm sure all of that is due to not being able to make payments on time but over {$24000.00} left seems a big excessive to pay for a car that probably isn't even worth the money it was financed for, especially for the problems and thousands of dollars of major work that I've had to get done after it reached a certain amount of miles and still isn't corrected properly. Also talking with Representatives over the last couple years of and on and in the last few months, no one can seem to tell me how they came up with and calculated the finance charge, interest rate in car note, just that they can only read me what's on the screen in front of them. The car totaled and was financed for {$20000.00} with a finance charge of {$19000.00} at an APR of 24 % which brings my total to [Redacted] after a {$500.00} deposit and a {$100.00} trade in they added the total and it brought it to {$41000.00}, none of this even looks right to me and of course they didn't explain any of it. After doing my own calculations and research all of the numbers either come close or don't add up. And using their percentage rate with the car note they gave me it seems like the percentage rate was actually almost 32 %. My car was bought brand new with 11 miles on it so the percentage rate shouldn't be due to that and I also found that by law the highest they can charge for a percentage rate is 16 %, but lenders get away with charging more. Also I'm seeing on my papers that my got warranty on my car has [Redacted]e different prices which I don't understand any of. My attachments show my buyer 's order, GAP coverage, calculations I made on my own and that I found on the website using loan calculators and two papers for mileage one which is 11 for my original mileage and the second for a mileage over {$22.00}, [Redacted] which I'm assuming maybe the mileage expected for the car or before it starts to have major issues I'm not sure, but if it is then my car was having major issues before it got to that mileage.

metadata.full_snippet:
[Redacted] is in violation of 15 U.S. Code 6802 - Obligations with respect to disclosures of personal information ( a ) Notice requirements Except as otherwise provided in this subchapter, a financial institution may not, directly or through any affiliate, disclose to a nonaffiliated third party any nonpublic personal information, unless such financial institution provides or has provided to the consumer a notice that complies with section 6803 of this title. ( b ) Opt out ( 1 ) In general A financial institution may not disclose nonpublic personal information to a nonaffiliated third party unless ( A ) such financial institution clearly and conspicuously discloses to the consumer, in writing or in electronic form or other form permitted by the regulations prescribed under section 6804 of this title, that such information may be disclosed to such third party ; ( B ) the consumer is given the opportunity, before the time that such information is initially disclosed, to direct that such information not be disclosed to such third party ; and ( C ) the consumer is given an explanation of how the consumer can exercise that nondisclosure option. 
[Redacted] may not disclose nonpublic personal information to a nonaffiliated third parties. [Redacted] has provided Transunion, [Redacted], and [Redacted] with information without providing me the consumer with disclosure in writing or electronic form or other form permitted by the regulations prescribed under section 6804 of this title. [Redacted] has not given me the consumer time that such information is initially disclosed, to direct that such information is not disclosed to such a third party. [Redacted] has also failed to give me the consumer an explanation on how I can exercise that nondisclosure option.

I made a purchase online with [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] for {$310.00} and {$14.00}. I returned entire order to company but they refused to pay me my refund. I put dispute in with Capital One. Once decision was made by Capital One to chargeback {$310.00}, one of the two purchases, I uploaded letter to Capital One dispute department on [Redacted]. Included with letter was all the emails, purchase order, [Redacted] letter, and Return policy. 

Capital One replied that I was denied due to [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] said they had " Confirmation showing No Cancellation policy received ''. I called Capital One to tell them that was not true and to refer to the emails [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] sent me confirming they would refund my money once order was received as well as to look at my purchase order showing nothing about Cancellation policy, only the return policy. Capital One replied, " at time we began an investigation into your dispute and requested information from you. While we have received your response to this request, it lacks all of the previously requested information needed to validate your dispute. Unfortunately, based on the information we have, we are unable to assist with your claim.If you still want to dispute the charge, please contact the merchant and work directly with them. At this time, we consider your case closed. '' I then emailed [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] asking for a copy of the Cancellation policy. Their reply was a link to the Return Policy. So I sent in another letter to Capital One along with [Redacted]  [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] reply email, not being able to show me Cancellation policy. I was denied again by Capital One. 

Why isn't Capital One asking [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] for a copy of their Cancellation policy? 
And, why did I get refunded for {$14.00}, but not {$310.00}? 

So end result, Capital One denied my dispute to refund me for remaining balance, {$310.00} to my Capital One Quick Silver Credit Card. I have also filed a complaint on [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] with California State Attorney General and trade commission. 

Thank you for your time,

metadata.full_snippet: The card in question is the [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] by OneMain Financial [Redacted] I applied for the card and was approved on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/23. I received the card on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/23. At the time I received the card it came to my attention that there was no web site available to monitor the card on my PC. Everything must be done via an app. I am a senior and not all that tech savvy and I have no apps on my cell, I pay all of my bills via a paper statement. I spent a week trying to get their website to work and was repeatedly told their " website was not available at this time '' and they do no issue paper statements. Via a phone call on [Redacted], I requested they close my account and SEND ME NOTIFICATION that my account was closed. I was told I would receive a letter verifying the account was closed. [Redacted] week later I called the number on the back of the card, which I had cut in half and via the phone I was told the account was open and what was available to spend. One week after that, I made another phone call and received the exact same information. On [Redacted], I spoke with a representative at that number and was told that system will tell me the account is open, but my account is closed. Huh????? How can it show it is open with an available balance but be closed?? I again asked for a written letter stating the account is closed via my request and here we are in [Redacted] and still no letter. I am getting no where with this company and I feel they keep giving me the run around ... .They could have typed and sent me a closed confirmation letter faster than I typed this to you. Can you help please get them so send me a written, paper letter verifying the account is actually closed? Thank you so much for your time. On a side note, I kind of feel it's kind of age discriminatory as many people in my age bracket and older don't use an app, don't even know how to use an app for them to issue a credit card without providing a website to use and monitor and for them not to mail out paper statements. Thank you again for your time. [Redacted] [Redacted]

The loan was scheduled to be paid off by [Redacted]. I have been overpaying by at least {$80.00} every month for the last 2 years to finish paying o...
metadata.full_snippet:
I have been on an amortization schedule with this lender that was pre-set when the loan began and saw no changes for over a decade. The loan was scheduled to be paid off by [Redacted]. I have been overpaying by at least {$80.00} every month for the last 2 years to finish paying off the loan faster. In [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I noticed my monthly payment had drastically increased, although the amortization schedule didn't list an increase until [Redacted] of [Redacted]. What's more, the increase was much more than specified in the amortization schedule. I had a couple of late payments, so I thought perhaps my overpayment hadn't been applied to the late fee, and it was rolling over. 

After reaching out to the servicer for clarification, however, I was told this was not the case and that my servicer had readjusted my payment schedule " to ensure I paid the loan off on time ''. I have been overpaying > {$80.00} to this servicer every month since at least [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and was poised to finish repaying the loan earlier than anticipated, so this reply doesn't make any sense. 

Furthermore, the new monthly payment is almost double the usual amount, and at least {$100.00} more than the expected amortization increase for [Redacted]. I checked my amortization schedule when I first noticed the monthly increase and it showed the schedule set at the start of the loan. I checked it again after receiving the reply from the servicer and saw that it had been changed to something very different and only shows the next few years at this new payment schedule, and not the entire schedule ( from the start of the loan ), like it used to. 

I believe this company is trying to make up for losses in interest payments, that may be arising from the potential upcoming student loan forgiveness legislation, by drastically increasing monthly payments. There is no reason for this sudden increase and change to my account. It is also very strange that they would hide all of the previous amortization information. Please look into this. The servicer is Navient. I have 2 FFELP loans through them.

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I received a notice from my credit report that your company has reported a delinquent debt on my account. However, I have already paid the invoice in full on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. 

I have made several attempts to contact [Redacted] [Redacted] to rectify this error, but have not received any response. This is unacceptable and is damaging my credit score, despite having paid the debt in full and on time. 

I demand that [Redacted] [Redacted] immediately rectify this error by removing the delinquent debt from my credit report. Furthermore, I expect an apology for the damage this has caused to my credit score and the inconvenience this has caused me. 

If I do not receive a response from them or if the issue is not resolved within 30 days, I will take appropriate legal action. 

I would appreciate a prompt response to this complaint, including confirmation that the delinquent debt will be removed from my credit report.

metadata.full_snippet: I am a user of Google Pay, an online wallet for credit cards to make payments through apps or other online transactions. Last [Redacted] someone hacked into my Google account and used my Google Pay account to purchase 12 Google [Redacted]  phones. The fraudulent charges totaled {$11000.00}. This was done using a stored [Redacted] issued credit card. Once I learned about this I immediately reported it to [Redacted] and I filed a police report with my local police department. [Redacted] took almost three months to resolve the issue and I had called them many times to get the fraudulent charges removed. In the meantime, Google kept suspending my Google Pay account and I had to keep calling them to get it reinstated ( which is very difficult to do since they make it hard to find a phone number call ). Now they have suspended my account and although I have called, they still haven't reinstated it and it has been over a month.

metadata.full_snippet:
Entered into a Vehicle Lease agreement with Hyundai Motors Finance [Redacted] ( [Redacted] ) on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022. 
Vehicle was involved in an accident on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 and subsequently determined a total loss on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 on Esurance claim # : [Redacted] Attempts by the claims [Redacted] to connect with ANYONE at [Redacted] were refused leading claims [Redacted] to instruct me via email on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 to initiate the request for Payoff from [Redacted]. 
Multiple attempts by me between [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 and [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 to obtain payoff information using HMFUSAs [Redacted] routing to payoff requests were instead dumped into general customer service queue and answered by abusive collections agents. 
Ultimately on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 [Redacted] PM [Redacted] received a verbal quote for a payoff amount of {$30000.00} good through [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 on a recorded line. That call was left with a guarantee from the call center agent that a payoff letter would be mailed out with that payoff information. That letter has not been received to this date. 
Payoff amount was provided to insurance [Redacted], and subsequently a check was cut and delivered to [Redacted] in the amount quoted. Check was received, cashed, and referenced as a received payment on my account on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/2022 ( see Figure [Redacted] ). 
As of this date, [Redacted] refuses to apply the payoff delivered despite the fact that the account shows {$0.00} amount due ( see Figure [Redacted] ) and full payoff amount received before good through date. Additionally, [Redacted] continues to accrue past due payments on my account and refuses to close the account out in good standing as paid in full. 
I have made repeated attempts to rectify this matter with Hyundai Motor Finance, but have no clear direct path to anyone of any degree of authority within [Redacted]. The only manner of contact I do have is to call their general customer service number, route through their [Redacted] only to be dumped into the general customer service queue. Once in the general customer service queue I repeatedly have to sit through the customer service agent of the days irreverent collections script with the agent ultimately only caring about collecting a payment from me. I then, once again need to explain to the general CS agent that I am calling in regards to an ongoing matter in which [Redacted] is fraudulently attempting to claim funds owed to which they have no legal claim. If I am lucky I may be re-routed to an escalated customer support team to help me resolve the matter. The sole focus of this support team is to continue demanding payment of amounts Hyundai Finance is not contractually due. Most times the resolution from general customer service team ends the call instructing me to have my insurance company contact Hyundai Finance to settle the matter. 
I feel the issues I encountered getting my claim settled with [Redacted] is a demonstration of continued violations expanding the claims in [Redacted]. 

I contend that [Redacted] and their parent company Hyundai Capital America ( [Redacted] ) have a long standing practice of defrauding their customers who have been involved in a total loss of property by reference a statement in section 20 of their lease agreement which claims they are entitled to all insurance proceeds in the event of a total loss, even those funds above the fair contractual value of the vehicle. I believe this clause in their lease contracts constitutes willful predatory fraud on the part of [Redacted] and [Redacted] which they have been abusing for a significant period of time, defrauding millions of customers at a time when those customers have already suffered significant harm and loss. 
Further I believe that Hyundai 's inclusion of the fraudulent claim to undue funds is a flagrant violation of several Federal regulations protecting consumers from such behavior, most notably : 12 CFR Part 213 213.3 ( 2 ) General disclosure requirements : Segregation of certain disclosures 12 CFR Part 213 213.4 Content of disclosures. Specifically subparagraphs ( g ) Early Termination and ( o ) Insurance 15 U.S. Code 1667a ( 7 ) Consumer Lease Disclosures : brief description of insurance coverages Lessee and lessor adding claim to funds at loss in here violates subchapter 11 below 15 U.S. Code 1667a ( 11 ) Consumer Lease Disclosures : mechanics for early termination hiding entitlement to insurance proceeds violates this 15 U.S. Code 1667b ( b ) 12 U.S. Code 5531 ( c ) ( 1 ) ( A ) 12 U.S. Code 5531 ( d ) ( 2 ) ( A ) - adding claim to funds in required insurance coverage mentioned above 12 U.S. Code 5531 ( d ) ( 2 ) ( B )

metadata.snippet: Subject : Notice of Dispute and Demand for Immediate Correction of Credit Report - Bankruptcy Information and Unreasonable Verification Timeframe Dear TransUnion, I am writing to emphatically dispute the egregiously inaccurate and unlawful information in my credit report ( [Redac...
metadata.full_snippet:
Subject : Notice of Dispute and Demand for Immediate Correction of Credit Report - Bankruptcy Information and Unreasonable Verification Timeframe Dear TransUnion, I am writing to emphatically dispute the egregiously inaccurate and unlawful information in my credit report ( [Redacted] ). As a responsible consumer, I have reviewed my credit report and discovered unacceptable errors regarding a bankruptcy being reported on my file, which has been provided to you by [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted]. 

The erroneous bankruptcy information on my credit report constitutes a violation of the Fair Credit Reporting Act 's ( FCRA ) requirement for accurate and complete reporting. 

Furthermore, I submitted a dispute regarding the validity of the bankruptcy on Saturday, [Redacted], and received a response on [Redacted] stating that the information had been verified as accurate. It is highly implausible for the information to have been verified within such a short timeframe, especially considering that the courts are not open on weekends. 

I have obtained a certified affidavit from the bankruptcy courts, which explicitly states that they do not provide verification to credit reporting agencies ( CRAs ) or third-party agencies and will not certify the information within [Redacted] as accurate. This affidavit confirms that your verification method has been invalidated, which violates the FCRA Section 611 and Illinois state law. Given this statement from the courts, it is unclear how TransUnion and [Redacted] [Redacted] [Redacted] can claim the bankruptcy information as valid and verified. 

The continued reporting of this inaccurate bankruptcy information demonstrates a blatant disregard for legal precedent, established guidelines, and a lack of due diligence on the part of your agency. This illegal reporting practice not only disregards federal law but may also infringe on Illinois 's state laws and statutes governing credit reporting and consumer protection, such as the Illinois Fair Credit Reporting Act ( 815 ILCS 137/ ) and the Illinois Consumer Fraud and Deceptive Business Practices Act ( 815 ILCS 505/ ). 


It is my unequivocal demand that you commence an immediate investigation into this matter and expunge the erroneous bankruptcy information from my credit report without delay. 
Enclosed is a copy of the certified affidavit from the bankruptcy courts and the relevant portion of my credit report for your reference. 

In compliance with the FCRA, your agency is legally obligated to conclude the investigation within 30 days of receipt of this dispute letter. Upon completing the investigation, I expect to receive an updated copy of my credit report and written confirmation of the rectifications. 

Failure to address this dispute promptly and accurately may result in legal action against your agency, including claims for damages under the FCRA, Illinois 's state laws, and any other applicable laws and regulations.

metadata.full_snippet: Navient mistakenly reported a 1099-C for loan forgiveness on me in [Redacted]  and I was the cosigner on my son 's loan, not a co-borrower. They also sent one to my son who has since paid the taxes on the forgiveness. A cosigner is not viewed as a debtor according to Treasury Regulation 1.6050P-1 ( 7 ). This double reporting results in increased tax write-offs for them and the IRS gets to unknowingly double dip and collect from two individuals. This practice seems to be common as [Redacted] [Redacted] did the same thing and I will complete a separate complaint on them. This is fraudulent and most likely is now standard practice for these loan companies. The amount of loan forgiveness reported was {$8300.00}. I have contacted Navient several times by phone and talked to several individuals. Their records are disorganized as some of this loan information was in my son 's file and some in my file as I have a personal student loan with them. Each time I call I have to go through the whole scenario again. Once they understand the situation they always say another department or supervisor would have to help. After four months of dealing with this, I have sent a letter requesting a redacted 1099-C for [Redacted]  to be sent to the IRS. I feel the runaround I have been receiving is purposeful.

On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I pulled my credit report and noticed that there was some inaccurate information regarding my credit score. My consumer credit reports have been ruined due to the businesss abusive and deceptive practices. I contacted the credit card agency with a letter regarding my findings and still have not received a response and it has been more than 30 days since the letter has been sent. My complaints were as followed : To whom it may concern : Please note that this is not a refusal to pay off the account but a notice sent as per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ), 15 U.S.C. 1692 ( G ) Section 809 ( B ). This notice states that your claim is disputed and validation of the account is required. As I did not authorize consent for Chase/JPMCB cardholder services to report anything on my consumer report. Pursuant to federal law 15 U.S.C. 1692 a ( 3 ) When I pulled my consumer credit reports on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] I noticed that my credit reports have been ruined by this company on information that has not been validated. My consumer credit reports have been ruined due to the businesss abusive and deceptive practices. I noticed that there were inaccuracies on my consumer reports, such as the balance of {$3400.00}, late payments and a closed account reported by your company. This has destroyed the lively hood for my children and I to live sustainably, such as purchasing a home of our own, and being able to take care of their necessities. This is very disheartening for me and caused a lot of emotional distress for myself and my children. 

This notice is not a request for verification of the account or proof of my mailing address but a request for validation made pursuant to the FDCPA laws. I humbly request that your agency/office sends me valid proof of claim that I am legally obligated to pay you and that late payments were made and updated pursuant to 15 U.S.C 1666B. I am demanding the removal of the negative items if the information is not validated. ( A copy of any sort is not evidence ) The original must be furnished with WET INK SIGNATURE, including 3-308, and 3-302 ) and proof that it is my signature. Pursuant to federal law 15 U.S.C. 1681 as well as the Fair Credit Billing Act 15 U.S.C 1666-1666j., federal law states that you can not report anything adversely on my consumer credit report until the investigation is complete. 


Please provide me with the below-mentioned items : * The amount you claim the Respondent owes you * An explanation showing me how you have computed the amount. 

* Copies of any documents that prove I agreed to pay the alleged amount pursuant to Federal Law UCC 8-315 * Confirmation that the account has not crossed the statute of limitation ( SOL ) period * Evidence of your license numbers and your registered agent. 

I would like to inform you that in case your agency has reported invalidated account information to any of the three main credit bureaus such as [Redacted], [Redacted], or [Redacted], then it will be regarded as a fraudulent action under both federal and state statutes. Due to this reason, if any negative item is reported to any of my credit reports by your agency or the agency that you represent, then I will be compelled to take legal steps against you for the below-mentioned reasons under 15 U.S.C. 1692 ( a ) ( 1 ) as well as the following : *Misuse of my copyrighted property *Violation of the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( F.C.R.A. ) *Defamation of character *Violation of the F.D.C.P.A *No consent was given *Invasion of privacy I would like to inform you further that if any action is taken during the validation period which could be regarded as detrimental to any of my credit reports, then I will seek advice about initiating a lawsuit. This includes listing any information on a credit report that could be incorrect or invalidated, or confirming an account as correct when, in fact, there is no provided evidence that it is. 

If your agency can provide me with the requested documents, I will need a minimum of thirty ( 30 ) days to investigate this information, and during this period of time, all collection activities must be stopped. 

Also, I request that you provide evidence that I must pay you in anything other than appropriate commercial paper should the debt be proven valid because, to my knowledge, the U.S. Congress provided the appropriate solution for me to settle my debts via the remedy in House Joint Resolution ( H.J.R. ) [Redacted] of [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], under the United States, Public Law 73-10, and Public Law 48 stat. 112 ( among others ). 

If your agency/company fails to respond to this debt validation request within a period of ten ( 10 ) days from the date of your receipt of my notice and affidavit, then the account information must be completely deleted from my credit report, and a copy of such deletion request should be sent to me at once, or I will take legal action. 

I would also like to request, in writing, that no calls should be made by your agency or company at my residence or workplace. If your agency attempts to make unlimited or computer-generated calls to me or any third parties, then it will be considered harassment, and I will have no option but to file a lawsuit. All future communications with me should be done in writing and sent to the address mentioned in this letter. Further, any correspondence must be made in the form of a commercial affidavit under penalty of perjury and sent by certified mail. Any other form of service shall be deemed defective upon its face. 

It would be advisable that you assure that your records are in order before I am forced to take legal action. This is an attempt to correct your records. Any information obtained shall be used for that purpose. 



Respectfully, _________________________________ [Redacted] : [Redacted] Without [Redacted] [Redacted]

metadata.full_snippet:
On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I leased a [Redacted] from Hyundai. Back in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I was laid off from my job due to the pandemic. I called Hyundai Motor Finance ( HMF ) in the month of [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] to have my payment deferred on my lease because I was uncertain of my financial situation. The person on the phone said it was ok to do since people everywhere were getting laid off. They explained that my payment will be pushed to the end of the loan. I then called back in [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and they explained the same thing regarding my [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] payment being deferred. I noticed on my [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] payment statement, my lease maturity date was not [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] ( the original date ), but [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted]. Since they told me that the payments were thrown at the end of the loan, it made sense that two deferred payments extended my lease date to pay for those payments ONLY. However, on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], when I received my last bill, it was for {$950.00}. I called HMF the same day at [Redacted] [Redacted]  CT and the agent said it was because my loan was deferred for two months, so that bill includes the two deferred payments and my last monthly payment. I told them, yes it was deferred for two months but my original lease maturity date was [Redacted] [Redacted] which is why [Redacted] [Redacted] is the new one. She was not really sure after 45 minutes of being on the call. I then called 8 more times after that and talked to other agents and supervisors and no one knew what to do or what had happened. The only common response from everyone was that I had two payments deferred, but I explained that I have already paid 39 payments for the [Redacted] lease for {$12000.00} which is the same amount in my contract for the lease agreement which is {$12000.00}. 

However, I was not told until yesterday, [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] at [Redacted] CT, my lease went from 39 months to 41 months because I kept the car longer and it was explained to me, which is not true. I even asked if they had pulled up the transcript that is recorded from [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] and [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] conversations with the agent and they did not and will not. They failed to do their due diligence. HMF is failing to admit to its mistakes, yet they said multiple times that their system ADDED payments because it didn't know how to defer lease payments. So they are penalizing me to pay for something that their system messed up. I should not be penalized for their broken payment system. I would've never agreed to extend my lease for 2 more months, 3 years ago. That does not make any logical sense, because I knew I was going to be working again. HMF is violating my lease agreement and they don't want to be held responsible.

metadata.full_snippet:
On [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], I pulled my credit report and noticed that there was some inaccurate information regarding my credit score. I noticed that my credit reports have been ruined by this company on information that has not been validated. My consumer credit reports have been ruined due to the businesss abusive and deceptive practices. I contacted the credit card agency with a letter regarding my findings and still have not received a response and it has been more than 30 days since the letter has been sent. My complaints were as followed : To whom it may concern : Please note that this is not a refusal to pay off the account but a notice sent as per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ), 15 U.S.C. 1692 ( G ) Section 809 ( B ). This notice states that your claim is disputed and validation of the account is required. As I did not authorize consent for Wells Fargo Card Holder Services to report anything on my consumer report. Pursuant to federal law 15 U.S.C. 1692 a ( 3 ) When I pulled my consumer credit reports on [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted] I noticed that my credit reports have been ruined by this company on information that has not been validated. My consumer credit reports have been ruined due to the businesss abusive and deceptive practices. I noticed that there were inaccuracies on my consumer reports, such as the balance of {$10000.00} and late payments reported by your company. This has destroyed the lively hood for my children and I to live sustainably, such as purchasing a home of our own, and being able to take care of their necessities. This is very disheartening for me and caused a lot of emotional distress for myself and my children. 

This notice is not a request for verification of the account or proof of my mailing address but a request for validation made pursuant to the FDCPA laws. I humbly request that your agency/office sends me valid proof of claim that I am legally obligated to pay you and that late payments were made and updated pursuant to 15 U.S.C 1666B. I am demanding the removal of the negative items if the information is not validated. ( A copy of any sort is not evidence ) The original must be furnished with WET INK SIGNATURE, including 3-308, and 3-302 ) and proof that it is my signature. Pursuant to federal law 15 U.S.C. 1681 as well as the Fair Credit Billing Act 15 U.S.C 1666-1666j., federal law states that you can not report anything adversely on my consumer credit report until the investigation is complete. 


Please provide me with the below-mentioned items : * The amount you claim the Respondent owes you * An explanation showing me how you have computed the amount. 

* Copies of any documents that prove I agreed to pay the alleged amount pursuant to Federal Law UCC 8-315 * Confirmation that the account has not crossed the statute of limitation ( SOL ) period * Evidence of your license numbers and your registered agent. 

I would like to inform you that in case your agency has reported invalidated account information to any of the three main credit bureaus such as [Redacted], [Redacted], or [Redacted], then it will be regarded as a fraudulent action under both federal and state statutes. Due to this reason, if any negative item is reported to any of my credit reports by your agency or the agency that you represent, then I will be compelled to take legal steps against you for the below-mentioned reasons under 15 U.S.C. 1692 ( a ) ( 1 ) as well as the following : *Misuse of my copyrighted property *Violation of the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( F.C.R.A. ) *Defamation of character *Violation of the F.D.C.P.A *No consent was given *Invasion of privacy I would like to inform you further that if any action is taken during the validation period which could be regarded as detrimental to any of my credit reports, then I will seek advice about initiating a lawsuit. This includes listing any information on a credit report that could be incorrect or invalidated, or confirming an account as correct when, in fact, there is no provided evidence that it is. 

If your agency can provide me with the requested documents, I will need a minimum of thirty ( 30 ) days to investigate this information, and during this period of time, all collection activities must be stopped. 

Also, I request that you provide evidence that I must pay you in anything other than appropriate commercial paper should the debt be proven valid because, to my knowledge, the U.S. Congress provided the appropriate solution for me to settle my debts via the remedy in House Joint Resolution ( H.J.R. ) 192 of [Redacted]/[Redacted]/[Redacted], under the United States, Public Law 73-10, and Public Law 48 stat. 112 ( among others ).

If your agency/company fails to respond to this debt validation request within a period of ten ( 10 ) days from the date of your receipt of my notice and affidavit, then the account information must be completely deleted from my credit report, and a copy of such deletion request should be sent to me at once, or I will take legal action. 

I would also like to request, in writing, that no calls should be made by your agency or company at my residence or workplace. If your agency attempts to make unlimited or computer-generated calls to me or any third parties, then it will be considered harassment, and I will have no option but to file a lawsuit. All future communications with me should be done in writing and sent to the address mentioned in this letter. Further, any correspondence must be made in the form of a commercial affidavit under penalty of perjury and sent by certified mail. Any other form of service shall be deemed defective upon its face. 

It would be advisable that you assure that your records are in order before I am forced to take legal action. This is an attempt to correct your records. Any information obtained shall be used for that purpose. 



Respectfully, _________________________________ [Redacted] : [Redacted] Without [Redacted] [Redacted]
